site.description: Everything Dam Hong Duc publishes, in one place: app privacy policies, setup guides, a video-editing effects library, a portfolio and a CV.

sections.title: Who we are
body: {{app}} is developed and published by {{publisher}} ("we", "us", "our"). This Privacy Policy explains what information the app handles, why it is handled, and the choices you have.
By installing or using {{app}} you agree to the practices described on this page. If you do not agree, please stop using the app and remove it from your device.

sections.title: How information is used
body: Any information described in the sections above is used only for the purposes listed there. We do not sell your personal information, and we do not use it to build advertising profiles about you outside of the third-party services listed on this page.

sections.title: Data retention
body: Data that stays on your device is kept until you delete it or uninstall {{app}}. Data processed by the third-party services listed above is retained according to each provider's own retention policy.
You can request deletion of any data associated with you by writing to {{email}}. We respond to deletion requests within 30 days.

sections.title: Security
body: We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect information handled by {{app}}, including encrypted transport (HTTPS/TLS) for anything that leaves your device.
No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: Children's privacy
body: {{app}} is not directed at children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, contact {{email}} and we will delete it.

sections.title: Your rights
body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, export, or delete your personal information, and to object to or restrict certain processing.
list: Access — ask what information we hold about you.
Correction — ask us to fix information that is inaccurate.
Deletion — ask us to erase information associated with you.
Withdrawal of consent — turn off optional permissions at any time in your device settings.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy as {{app}} evolves. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page always reflects the current version, and material changes will be announced inside the app before they take effect.

sections.title: Contact us
body: If you have questions about this policy or about how {{app}} handles your data, email us at {{email}} and we will get back to you.
